Cyril Shroff and IIM Ahmedabad Launch Leadership Academy

Cyril Shroff, along with IIM Ahmedabad, has co-founded the Cyril Shroff - IIMA GC Leadership Academy. The academy aims to fuel corporate growth by bridging the gap between General Counsel roles and CEO positions. The launch was announced by Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas and IIM-A.
